name: zkBridge (Polyhedra)
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet. 30+ L1/L2 networks, 20M+ cross-chain txns verified. LayerZero DVN integration live.
zk_use: Trustless cross-chain bridge: ZKPs prove block header validity and state transitions on source chain to a light-client contract on destination chain, enabling token bridging and message passing without external trust assumptions.
proof_system: zk-SNARK (Groth16 STARK->SNARK wrapper) + deVirgo (GKR-based transparent SNARK, no trusted setup)

name: Hyperlane
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet. Live on 150+ chains. $1.7B+ lifetime bridge volume. EVM, Cosmos, Solana, Starknet ecosystems.
zk_use: Permissionless cross-chain interoperability framework. ZKPs are one optional ISM (Interchain Security Module) used for trustless light-client verification of cross-chain messages. Primary current security is multisig-based.
proof_system: Modular - SNARK/STARK depending on ISM chosen (Groth16, Plonky3 via SP1, or STARK via Cairo). ZK is pluggable.

name: zkSync Era
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet since March 2023. Billions in TVL. Millions of ZK proofs generated. Major DeFi protocols deployed. ZK Stack ecosystem growing.
zk_use: Ethereum L2 ZK Rollup: ZKPs (validity proofs) prove correct execution of batches of EVM-compatible transactions, allowing state updates settled on Ethereum without re-execution.
proof_system: zk-SNARK wrapping zk-STARK (Boojum/FRI + Groth16). PLONKish arithmetization. Trusted setup for Groth16 wrapper.

name: Starknet
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet since 2022. Top-25 chain by TVL. One of the first ZK rollups in production. Millions of transactions proven.
zk_use: Ethereum L2 ZK Rollup using STARKs. ZKPs validate correct execution of Cairo VM programs (smart contracts) and batch state transitions, settled on Ethereum.
proof_system: zk-STARK (transparent, no trusted setup). FRI-based polynomial commitments. Recursive STARKs for compression.

name: Linea
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet (launched August 2023, by Consensys). Significant TVL and transaction volume. EVM-equivalent zkEVM.
zk_use: Ethereum L2 zkEVM: ZKPs prove valid execution of standard EVM bytecode, enabling Ethereum-equivalent smart contracts at reduced cost, with proofs settled on Ethereum L1.
proof_system: zk-SNARK: PLONK with KZG commitments (gnark library). Trusted setup required (KZG ceremony). Type 2 equivalent zkEVM.

name: Axiom zkOracle
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet (Ethereum, since Jan 2024). Axiom V2 on mainnet, pivoted to OpenVM in late 2024. Axiom Proving API in production. OpenVM proving Ethereum mainnet blocks live.
zk_use: ZK coprocessor/zkOracle for Ethereum: allows smart contracts to trustlessly read and compute over all historical Ethereum on-chain data via ZK proofs.
proof_system: zk-SNARK: halo2/PLONKish with KZG commitments (original). OpenVM: modular zkVM (STARK-based, SNARK-wrapped). Trusted setup via perpetual powers-of-tau ceremony.

name: Herodotus zkOracle
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet. Storage Proofs live on Ethereum and Starknet. Herodotus Data Processor (HDP) available via Atlantic prover service.
zk_use: ZK infrastructure for cross-chain data access: Storage Proofs cryptographically verify on-chain data (account balances, storage slots, block headers). HDP adds ZK compute layer for verifiable custom programs over proven multi-chain data.
proof_system: zk-STARK (Cairo VM + SHARP/Stone prover). FRI-based, transparent, no trusted setup.

name: Brevis
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet. 124M+ proofs generated. $2.8B+ in TVL served. Integrations: PancakeSwap, Uniswap v4, Euler, Linea, Coinbase EigenLayer operator.
zk_use: ZK data coprocessor + zkVM: allows smart contracts to trustlessly access and compute over full historical on-chain data. Used for data-driven DeFi (fee discounts, reward distribution, reputation), cross-chain verification, and verifiable AI inference (zkML).
proof_system: zk-SNARK/STARK hybrid. Pico uses PLONKish/STARKish arithmetization with modular backends. Groth16 or PLONK for on-chain verification.

name: Lagrange
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet since June 4, 2024 (EigenLayer AVS). 85+ operators. ZK Prover Network live. Decentralized ZKsync ZK Stack prover tested late 2024.
zk_use: Universal ZK prover network + ZK coprocessor + ZK state committees: proves AI inferences, rollup state, cross-chain state proofs, SQL queries over blockchain data.
proof_system: zk-SNARK (Groth16, PLONK variants). Dynamic zk-SNARKs (updatable). Custom proving stack for ZKsync ZK Stack integration.

name: =nil, Foundation
deployment_status: YES (partial) - =nil, zkSharding testnet/early mainnet phases. Proof Market live. Placeholder zkOracle services operational.
zk_use: ZK proof generation marketplace + zkSharding L1 blockchain + trustless data access. ZKPs for sharded blockchain execution, cross-chain data bridging via SNARK-proven state queries, and general proof-as-a-service.
proof_system: zk-SNARK: PLONK, Halo2, Groth16 (toolkit supports multiple).

name: zkLink
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet. zkLink Nova (multi-chain rollup aggregation) live. zkLink X (ZK-Stack appchains). Aggregates liquidity across zkSync, Starknet, etc.
zk_use: ZK-powered multi-chain DeFi infrastructure: ZKPs aggregate state from multiple ZK L2s into a unified liquidity layer. Enables unified order books and cross-chain DeFi without asset bridging.
proof_system: zk-SNARK (PLONKish, Boojum/Groth16 from ZK Stack). Aggregation of proofs from multiple ZK rollups.

name: Taiko
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet launched May 2024. Type-1 (Ethereum-equivalent) zkEVM. Significant TVL and active ecosystem.
zk_use: Type-1 zkEVM Ethereum L2: ZKPs prove correct execution of native Ethereum blocks (unchanged EVM, unchanged state representation). ZK validity proofs settle on Ethereum L1.
proof_system: Multiple ZK systems: zk-STARK (SP1/Plonky3, Risc0), SGX (TEE). Groth16 SNARK wrapping for on-chain verification.

name: Loopring
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet since 2019. One of the earliest production ZK rollups. DEX and payment protocol. Fees <$0.50 vs $50+ on mainnet during congestion.
zk_use: ZK Rollup for decentralized exchange (DEX) and payments. ZKPs prove correct execution of trade matching, token transfers, and order book updates, enabling high-throughput trading with Ethereum security at low cost.
proof_system: zk-SNARK: Groth16 on BN254. Application-specific circuits (not general zkEVM). Trusted setup performed.

name: Polymer
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet. IBC-enabled interoperability for Ethereum rollups. Deployed on OP Stack chains (Base, Optimism, etc.).
zk_use: ZK-powered IBC for Ethereum rollups: ZKPs prove the state of Ethereum rollups to enable native IBC messaging between EVM chains without custom bridges.
proof_system: zk-SNARK/STARK (SP1 or custom, wrapping in Groth16/PLONK for on-chain verification). ZK light client proving OP Stack state transitions.

name: SP1 (Succinct Labs)
deployment_status: YES - Production. $1B+ in TVL secured. Used by Celestia, Wormhole, Lido, Avail, Near, Gnosis, Taiko, Alpen, and many more. Verifiers on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Scroll.
zk_use: General-purpose zkVM: allows any Rust program (or LLVM-compiled language) to generate ZK proofs. Used for ZK light clients, ZK rollups (zkEVMs), ZK bridges, coprocessors, proof aggregation.
proof_system: zk-STARK (Plonky3, FRI-based) + Groth16 SNARK wrapper for on-chain verification. Transparent STARKs, trusted setup only for Groth16 wrapper.

name: Electron Labs
deployment_status: YES (partial) - zkBridge between Ethereum and Near mainnet live. ZK ISM module for Hyperlane in development.
zk_use: ZK light client bridge: ZKPs verify Ed25519 signatures from Cosmos SDK (and NEAR) on Ethereum without additional trust assumptions. ZK ISM for Hyperlane provides ZK-secured interchain messaging.
proof_system: zk-SNARK (Circom-based Groth16 or PLONK). Ed25519 circuit verification is expensive to express as arithmetic circuits.

name: Telepathy Circuits (Succinct)
deployment_status: YES (production reference) - Telepathy ZK light client deployed, later superseded by SP1-based implementations.
zk_use: ZK light client for Ethereum: ZK circuits verify Ethereum sync committee signatures (BLS12-381), proving a block header was signed by the Ethereum validator committee. Enables trustless cross-chain bridging.
proof_system: zk-SNARK (Circom/Groth16 or gnark/PLONK). BLS12-381 pairing operations expressed as arithmetic circuits.

name: Celer Bridge (cBridge)
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet. One of the largest cross-chain bridges by volume. Multi-chain deployment (40+ chains). Billions in cumulative volume.
zk_use: Cross-chain bridge and messaging. Primary security: State Guardian Network (SGN). ZK used experimentally for specific light client verification components and zkBridge features.
proof_system: Not primarily ZK - validator/SGN based. ZK used experimentally for light client components. No single ZK proof type dominates production.

name: Avail
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet (Avail Turing, mainnet phase 1 live 2024). DA Layer used by multiple rollups. Nexus (ZK aggregation) in development.
zk_use: Modular data availability (DA) layer with ZK-verified data availability sampling. ZKPs (via KZG vector commitments) prove data availability without downloading full blocks. Avail Nexus aggregates rollup proofs across chains using Avail DA.
proof_system: KZG commitments (polynomial commitments, trusted setup). ZK aggregation via SP1 (STARK+SNARK) or Risc0. DA-focused, not a classical ZK rollup.

name: Union
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet (launched 2024). Cross-chain interoperability protocol. IBC-compatible with ZK light clients.
zk_use: ZK-powered universal cross-chain interoperability: ZK light clients prove consensus state of source chain to destination chain without trusted relayers. Enables IBC-like trustless messaging between any chains.
proof_system: zk-SNARK (Gnark/PLONK or Groth16). BLS12-381 signature verification circuits. KZG-based commitments.

name: AggLayer (Polygon)
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet (v1 live 2024). Polygon CDK chains connected. Unified bridge for Polygon ZK ecosystem.
zk_use: ZK aggregation layer for unified cross-chain liquidity and messaging across Polygon CDK chains. ZKPs aggregate validity proofs from multiple ZK rollups into a single pessimistic proof verified on Ethereum.
proof_system: zk-SNARK: Pessimistic Proof uses PLONK or Groth16 (Polygon's prover stack). SP1 integration available for CDK chains.

name: Scroll
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet since October 2023. Significant TVL ($400M+). Zero contract modification needed (bytecode-level EVM equivalence). Aave, Uniswap deployed. SCR token October 2024.
zk_use: Type 2 zkEVM Ethereum L2: ZKPs prove correct execution of EVM bytecode at bytecode level, enabling full Ethereum equivalence. Proofs settled on Ethereum L1. Migrating to Type 1 using OpenVM.
proof_system: zk-SNARK: PLONK with KZG commitments (halo2). Trusted setup (KZG ceremony). Type 2 transitioning to Type 1.

name: Citrea
deployment_status: YES (testnet/devnet) - First Bitcoin ZK Rollup announced. Testnet live 2024. Mainnet not yet launched.
zk_use: ZK rollup on Bitcoin: ZKPs prove correct execution of EVM-compatible smart contracts, with state roots and proofs posted to Bitcoin. Enables smart contracts secured by Bitcoin's PoW without a soft fork.
proof_system: zk-SNARK/STARK (SP1 or Risc0) for EVM execution proofs. Bitcoin cannot natively verify ZK proofs - BitVM-inspired design used.

name: vlayer
deployment_status: YES (early mainnet beta 2025) - ZK-powered Solidity extensions for web proofs, time travel, and teleport.
zk_use: ZK Solidity extensions: smart contracts access ZK-verified off-chain data (web proofs via zkTLS), historical on-chain data (time travel), and cross-chain data (teleport). Runs Solidity in a zkVM.
proof_system: zk-STARK (Risc0 zkVM, RISC-V based). Groth16 SNARK wrapper for on-chain EVM verification.

name: RISC Zero
deployment_status: YES - Production. Bonsai proving service live. Verifiers on Ethereum mainnet. Used by Taiko, vlayer, Citrea, Steel. $55M Series A (Paradigm, a16z).
zk_use: General-purpose zkVM: ZK verifiable computing for any program on RISC-V architecture. Used for ZK rollups, ZK bridges, coprocessors, type-0 zkEVM (Zeth), private computation, verifiable AI.
proof_system: zk-STARK (FRI-based, RISC-V ISA) + Groth16 SNARK wrapper for on-chain verification. Trusted setup for Groth16 wrapper (238-contributor ceremony).

name: ZKM
deployment_status: YES (testnet/early) - zkMIPS prover deployed. Entangled Rollup Network testnet live. Mainnet not fully live.
zk_use: General-purpose zkVM (zkMIPS) + Entangled Rollup Network: ZKPs of MIPS instruction execution enable any program to be proven. Entangled Rollups allow any chain to become settlement layer for ZKM rollups.
proof_system: zk-STARK (FRI, MIPS-based VM) + SNARK wrapper. MIPS ISA (vs. more common RISC-V). No trusted setup for STARK portion.

name: Aligned Layer
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet since December 2024. Proof Verification Layer (PVL) live with $11B+ economic security (EigenLayer AVS, 52 operators). Proof Aggregation Service mainnet alpha January 2026.
zk_use: ZK proof verification aggregation layer: makes verifying ZK proofs on Ethereum fast, cheap, and scalable. PVL offloads proof verification to decentralized EigenLayer operators. PAS aggregates many proofs recursively into one Ethereum-verified proof. Reduces per-proof gas by up to 99%.
proof_system: Proof system agnostic - supports SP1 (STARK+SNARK), Risc0 (STARK+SNARK), Groth16 (SNARK), PLONK (SNARK). Not a proof system itself.

name: Nebra UPA
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet. Universal Proof Aggregation (UPA) service live. Used by Brevis and other ZK projects.
zk_use: Universal Proof Aggregation (UPA): aggregates ZK proofs from multiple applications and proof systems into batched submissions, drastically reducing on-chain verification cost.
proof_system: Proof system agnostic aggregator. Recursive zk-SNARK (Groth16 or PLONK) for batch aggregation.

name: Mina Protocol
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet since March 2021. The lightest blockchain at ~22KB constant chain size. zkApps live. o1js framework for developers.
zk_use: L1 blockchain with recursive ZK proofs: entire Mina chain state represented as a single constant-size zk-SNARK (~22KB). Users verify chain with a single proof. zkApps (ZK smart contracts) use o1js to define application logic as ZK circuits executed client-side.
proof_system: zk-SNARK: Kimchi (PLONKish) + Pickles recursion + IPA commitments. No trusted setup (IPA is transparent). Recursive zk-SNARKs for constant-size chain.

name: ZeroSync
deployment_status: YES (PoC/testnet) - Bitcoin light client ZK proof demonstrated. Full chain sync via ZK proof in development. Not full mainnet deployment yet.
zk_use: ZK proofs for Bitcoin: enables instant Bitcoin node sync by proving the entire Bitcoin chain history with a single ZK proof. Long-term goal: trustless Bitcoin state proofs for sidechains and bridges.
proof_system: zk-STARK (Cairo VM + SHARP). FRI-based, transparent, no trusted setup. Same proof system as Starknet.

name: Penumbra
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet launched June 2024. Privacy-focused Cosmos zone. DEX, staking, governance all with ZK privacy.
zk_use: Private L1 blockchain: ZKPs provide shielded transactions (private transfers, staking, DEX trading, governance) on a Cosmos-compatible chain. Every interaction uses ZK proofs to hide amounts and identities while proving validity.
proof_system: zk-SNARK: Groth16 on BLS12-377 curve. Trusted setup per circuit type. Similar in design to Zcash Sapling.

name: Aztec Network
deployment_status: YES (alpha mainnet 2025) - Aztec alpha launched 2025. $100M raised (a16z). ~3959 validators. Private smart contracts live.
zk_use: Private smart contract L2 on Ethereum: ZKPs enable fully private smart contract execution - both transaction inputs and smart contract state can be private. Hybrid ZK rollup: public and private execution combined. Noir language for private contracts.
proof_system: zk-SNARK: UltraPlonk (PLONKish, KZG) transitioning to Honk (multilinear + FRI). UltraPlonk: trusted setup, Honk: transparent.

name: Namada
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet launched 2024. Proof-of-Stake L1 with shielded transfers across assets and chains (interchain privacy). IBC-compatible.
zk_use: Multi-asset shielded transfers across blockchains: ZKPs enable private transfers of any IBC-compatible asset through a unified shielded pool. Interchain privacy.
proof_system: zk-SNARK: Groth16 on BLS12-381. MASP circuits (extension of Zcash Sapling). Trusted setup (Sapling ceremony parameters used and extended).

name: Hyli
deployment_status: YES (devnet) - Proof-agnostic L1 blockchain. Devnet launched. Mainnet not yet live.
zk_use: Proof-agnostic L1 blockchain: state transitions validated by ZK proofs rather than re-execution. Any proof system (SP1, Risc0, Groth16, Plonk, etc.) can be used to prove transactions.
proof_system: Proof-agnostic - supports zk-SNARK (Groth16, PLONK) and zk-STARK (SP1, Risc0). Not tied to a single proof system.

name: Gevulot
deployment_status: YES (testnet) - Decentralized proving network testnet live. Mainnet in development.
zk_use: Decentralized permissionless ZK proving network: allows any ZK application to outsource proof generation to a decentralized network of provers with cryptographic guarantees on proof correctness.
proof_system: Proof-system agnostic - supports Groth16, PLONK, STARK-based systems. Infrastructure layer, not a proof system itself.

name: Kakarot zkEVM
deployment_status: YES (mainnet) - Kakarot launched on Starknet mainnet as a zkEVM. EVM-compatible execution on Starknet. Real-time proving milestone achieved.
zk_use: zkEVM written in Cairo: runs EVM bytecode on Starknet using STARK proofs. Enables Ethereum DApps to deploy on Starknet without modification. Also developing standalone EVM chain using STARK proofs.
proof_system: zk-STARK (Cairo VM + SHARP/Stone prover). FRI-based, transparent, no trusted setup. Inherited from Starknet infrastructure.

name: Alpen Labs
deployment_status: YES (early/testnet) - Bitcoin ZK Rollup infrastructure. Strata (Bitcoin rollup framework) in testnet. Using SP1 for ZK proofs.
zk_use: Bitcoin ZK Rollup infrastructure: ZKPs prove correct execution of EVM-compatible rollup transactions, settling state on Bitcoin. Enables smart contracts secured by Bitcoin PoW.
proof_system: zk-STARK (SP1/Plonky3) + Groth16 SNARK wrapper. Bitcoin cannot natively verify ZK proofs - BitVM-style challenge/response used.

name: Sindri
deployment_status: YES - Production. Managed ZK proof generation API/cloud service. Used by multiple projects for outsourced proving.
zk_use: ZK proving-as-a-service: managed cloud API for generating ZK proofs for any circuit/program. Developers upload circuits (Circom, Noir, Gnark, SP1, etc.) and Sindri handles proof generation at scale.
proof_system: Proof system agnostic - supports Groth16, PLONK, STARK, SNARK depending on framework submitted. Infrastructure layer.

name: Lumoz
deployment_status: YES (testnet/early mainnet) - ZK-RaaS (Rollup as a Service). Testnet live 2024. Multiple chains deployed on Lumoz infrastructure.
zk_use: ZK Rollup as a Service (ZK-RaaS): decentralized proving network for ZK rollups. Provides shared proving infrastructure. Proof mining rewards miners for generating ZK proofs.
proof_system: Proof-system dependent on rollup framework (PLONK, STARK, etc.). Infrastructure for any ZK proof.

name: Bankai
deployment_status: YES (PoC/research) - Ethereum consensus light client proof implemented. Not production deployment - research/PoC.
zk_use: ZK light client for Ethereum consensus: ZK proofs verify Ethereum sync committee signatures (BLS12-381) to prove beacon chain state transitions. Building block for trustless cross-chain bridges on other chains (e.g., Starknet).
proof_system: zk-STARK (Cairo VM). BLS12-381 pairing in Cairo circuits. Transparent, no trusted setup.

name: Intmax
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet (Intmax2). ZK rollup with stateless client design. Plasma-inspired with ZK proofs.
zk_use: Ultra-lightweight ZK rollup: ZKPs verify transactions with minimal on-chain data. Stateless clients maintain their own state locally. Very high throughput with minimal L1 footprint. Privacy features included.
proof_system: zk-SNARK/STARK (Plonky2/Plonky3 - FRI-based PLONKish). Transparent proving with efficient recursion.

name: Toposware
deployment_status: YES (testnet) - Topos protocol testnet live. ZK-based interoperability. Mainnet delayed/uncertain as of 2025.
zk_use: ZK-based multi-chain interoperability and shared sequencing: ZKPs prove execution of transactions across multiple subnets (sidechains), with cross-subnet communication verified by ZK proofs posted to a shared layer.
proof_system: zk-SNARK/STARK (Plonky2 - FRI + PLONKish). Transparent, no trusted setup.

name: Sovereign Labs
deployment_status: YES (testnet/SDK) - Sovereign SDK for ZK rollups released. Reference implementations on testnet. Mainnet rollups being built using SDK.
zk_use: Modular ZK rollup SDK: framework for building sovereign ZK rollups on any DA layer (Celestia, Ethereum, etc.). ZKPs prove correct execution of rollup transactions. Rollups control their own settlement.
proof_system: zk-STARK (Risc0 primary, STARK + Groth16 SNARK wrapper). Modular - other proof systems can be plugged in.

name: Espresso Systems
deployment_status: YES (testnet) - Espresso Sequencer integrated with multiple rollup frameworks. Decaf testnet live. OP Stack and Arbitrum integrations.
zk_use: Shared sequencing for ZK rollups: provides a decentralized, fast-finality sequencer serving multiple rollups simultaneously. ZKPs prove correct transaction ordering and inclusion. Enables cross-rollup atomic composability.
proof_system: zk-SNARK (UltraPlonk/Plonky2 - PLONKish). ZK proofs for sequencer state commitments and rollup settlement.

name: Fermah
deployment_status: YES (early mainnet) - Universal proof generation marketplace. Integrated with SP1, Risc0, Gnark. Production API available.
zk_use: Universal ZK proof generation marketplace: decentralized network of specialized provers that can generate any type of ZK proof. Developers submit requests, Fermah routes to optimal provers.
proof_system: Proof system agnostic - SP1 (STARK), Risc0 (STARK), Gnark (SNARK), and others. Infrastructure layer.

name: Zircuit
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet since 2024. ZK rollup with AI-powered sequencer security. Significant TVL.
zk_use: EVM-compatible ZK Rollup with AI-enhanced security: ZKPs prove correct EVM execution. AI-powered sequencer-level threat detection (SLS) can quarantine suspicious transactions before they are proven and finalized.
proof_system: zk-SNARK: PLONKish circuits for zkEVM. Standard EVM-compatible ZK rollup proof stack.

name: Morph
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet live 2024. Consumer-focused EVM-compatible L2. Hybrid Rollup design.
zk_use: Hybrid ZK + Optimistic Rollup (Optimistic zkEVM): combines optimistic rollup speed with ZK proof security. ZKPs validate state transitions after optimistic challenge window.
proof_system: zk-SNARK: PLONK (Gnark) for EVM execution circuits. Hybrid model - ZK not always generated, only on challenge.

name: RAILGUN
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet on Ethereum, BSC, Polygon, Arbitrum. Production privacy protocol. $5B+ in shielded volume.
zk_use: Privacy protocol for EVM networks: ZKPs enable private transactions and private DeFi interactions. Users shield tokens into RAILGUN, spend proofs allow private transfers and interactions with DeFi protocols without revealing wallet identity or transaction amounts.
proof_system: zk-SNARK: Groth16 on BN254. Application-specific privacy circuits. Trusted setup (BN254 parameters).

name: Aleo
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet launched 2024. Privacy-focused L1 blockchain. Leo programming language for private applications. $200M raised.
zk_use: Private application platform: ZKPs enable fully private smart contracts and applications on L1. Programs written in Leo compile to ZK circuits, execution is proven with ZKPs so computation is verifiable without revealing private inputs.
proof_system: zk-SNARK: Groth16 on BLS12-377. Trusted setup. Application-specific circuit generation from Leo programs.

name: Dusk Network
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet launched 2025. Privacy-focused L1 for regulated financial assets. Nightshade consensus.
zk_use: Regulated privacy L1: ZKPs enable confidential transactions and compliant privacy for financial instruments (securities, tokenized assets). Compliance with financial regulations via selective disclosure ZKPs.
proof_system: zk-SNARK: Groth16 (Phoenix transactions), PLONK (Nocturne/Rusk applications). BN254 and BLS12-381 curves. Trusted setup (Groth16 ceremony).

name: ATA Network (Automata)
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet. Multi-prover TEE + ZK attestation network. OP Stack integration. Machine attestation protocol for proof verification.
zk_use: Multi-prover attestation for Ethereum: ZK proofs combined with TEE (Trusted Execution Environment) attestations for multi-prover rollup security. Provides decentralized attestation of machine execution for rollup state correctness.
proof_system: zk-STARK (Risc0/SP1 component) + SGX TEE attestation. Hybrid ZK+TEE design.

name: Space and Time
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet beta since 2024. ZK-proven SQL queries. Integrated with Chainlink, Microsoft. $20M raised.
zk_use: Verifiable database and SQL coprocessor: ZKPs prove the correctness of SQL query results against a tamper-proof indexed database. Smart contracts can request SQL query results and verify correctness via on-chain ZK proof verification.
proof_system: zk-SNARK: custom Proof of SQL (PLONK-based circuits for SQL operations). Novel circuit design for database queries.

name: Lita Foundation
deployment_status: YES (beta/testnet) - Valida zkVM and proving infrastructure. Research-focused.
zk_use: ZK virtual machine (Valida zkVM) designed for efficient proof generation of general programs. LLVM integration for broader ZK adoption.
proof_system: Custom ZK proof system for Valida ISA. Appears to be STARK-based.

name: Nexus
deployment_status: YES (beta testnet) - Nexus zkVM and proof network beta live. Universal computation prover.
zk_use: Universal computation prover: ZKPs prove correct execution of any program on a universal RISC-V zkVM. Goal: create a verifiable internet where any computation can be proven correct.
proof_system: Folding scheme (Nova/SuperNova/HyperNova) + Spartan (zk-SNARK). IVC-based proving. Transparent, no trusted setup.

name: AltLayer
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet. Restaked Rollups (MACH AVS, SQUAD AVS, VITAL AVS). Multiple ZK rollup deployments as a service.
zk_use: Rollup-as-a-Service with ZK and optimistic options. ZKPs provide fast finality for ZK rollups deployed via AltLayer. VITAL AVS: decentralized ZK proof verification. MACH: fast finality. SQUAD: decentralized sequencing.
proof_system: Proof-system dependent on rollup framework chosen. PLONK, STARK, Groth16 all supported through partner integrations.

name: Midnight (IOG)
deployment_status: YES (devnet) - Midnight devnet available. Haskell-based smart contract language (Compact). Partner Chain of Cardano.
zk_use: Privacy-preserving smart contract platform: ZKPs enable selective disclosure of contract state. Developers choose which data to make public vs. private. Suitable for regulated industries requiring privacy with compliance.
proof_system: zk-SNARK: PLONK-based (Plonky2 or custom variant). Compact compiler generates circuits.

name: Eclipse
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet launched 2024. SVM (Solana VM) rollup on Ethereum (using Celestia for DA). EVM as settlement, SVM for execution.
zk_use: SVM Ethereum rollup: ZKPs prove correct execution of Solana VM instructions (SVM), settling on Ethereum. Enables Solana-speed execution with Ethereum security.
proof_system: zk-STARK (Risc0: RISC-V based) + Groth16 SNARK wrapper. Proving SVM execution on RISC-V zkVM.

name: Zeko
deployment_status: YES (testnet) - Zeko zkRollup for Mina Protocol (zkApps rollup). Testnet operational.
zk_use: ZK Rollup for Mina zkApps: ZKPs prove correct execution of Mina zkApp transactions, enabling higher throughput for Mina applications. Batch-proves multiple zkApp state transitions into a single rollup proof.
proof_system: zk-SNARK: Kimchi (PLONKish) + Pickles recursion (Mina's proof system). IPA commitments (transparent, no trusted setup).

name: Merlin Chain
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet launched 2024. Bitcoin L2 with ZK proofs. Significant TVL in Bitcoin ecosystem.
zk_use: Bitcoin L2 ZK rollup: ZKPs prove correct execution of EVM-compatible transactions settling on Bitcoin. Native Bitcoin assets used in EVM DeFi.
proof_system: zk-SNARK (PLONK or Groth16 based). Bitcoin cannot natively verify ZK proofs - multisig or BitVM fallback used.

name: Light Protocol
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet on Solana. ZK compressed accounts live. Multiple applications using Light for gas optimization.
zk_use: ZK compression for Solana: ZKPs prove validity of compressed account state, reducing on-chain storage costs by 100x+. Enables mass NFT minting, token distribution, and state-heavy applications at a fraction of normal cost.
proof_system: zk-SNARK: Groth16 or PLONK (Gnark). Optimized for Solana BPF verifier. Trusted setup (Groth16).

name: Plumo (Celo)
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet on Celo. Ultralight mobile client protocol using ZK proofs. Allows mobile phones to sync chain state cheaply.
zk_use: Ultralight mobile client via ZK proofs: ZKPs prove Celo's SNARK-friendly consensus (BLS multi-signatures), allowing mobile phones and light clients to verify chain state with a single ZK proof instead of downloading headers.
proof_system: zk-SNARK: Groth16 on BLS12-377 curve. BLS signature verification circuits. Trusted setup (Celo ceremony).

name: Anoma
deployment_status: YES (testnet) - Anoma testnet live. Namada (first production network using Anoma's architecture) on mainnet. Anoma mainnet in development.
zk_use: Intent-centric blockchain protocol with ZK privacy: ZKPs enable private transactions and private state in a generalized intent-satisfaction framework. Taiga is the private execution engine.
proof_system: zk-SNARK: Halo2 (PLONKish with IPA commitments, transparent, no trusted setup). Taiga circuits.

name: Zcash
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet since 2016. The original production ZK blockchain. Millions of shielded transactions. Multiple ZK upgrade cycles (Sprout->Sapling->Orchard).
zk_use: Privacy-preserving cryptocurrency: ZKPs (zk-SNARKs) prove validity of shielded transactions - sender, receiver, and amount are all hidden while the proof guarantees no double-spend and conservation of funds. The original blockchain ZK application.
proof_system: Sapling: zk-SNARK Groth16 (BLS12-381) - trusted setup. Orchard: Halo2 (PLONKish + IPA, transparent) - no trusted setup.

name: DarkFi
deployment_status: YES (testnet) - DarkFi testnet active. Research + developer community. Mainnet not yet launched.
zk_use: Anonymous DeFi (dark DeFi) platform: fully private smart contracts, DEX, and financial applications using ZKPs. Privacy by default for all transactions and contract interactions.
proof_system: zk-SNARK: Halo2 (PLONKish + IPA). Transparent, no trusted setup. Custom batched proof techniques.

name: Aleph Zero
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet since 2022. High-performance PoS L1 with privacy features. 1B+ transactions processed.
zk_use: High-performance L1 with private smart contracts: ZKPs used for specific privacy applications (LIMINAL framework, Shielder private payment protocol, privacy-preserving bridges and identity). Not all state transitions are ZK-proven.
proof_system: zk-SNARK: PLONK/Halo2 for privacy components (LIMINAL, Shielder). L1 with optional ZK privacy. Substrate-based chain.

name: Hyperbridge
deployment_status: YES - Mainnet live. Polkadot-based cross-chain protocol. ZK light clients for Ethereum and Polkadot bridging.
zk_use: Trustless cross-chain protocol using ZK consensus proofs: ZK proofs of Polkadot/Ethereum consensus enable trustless message passing and asset bridging between heterogeneous chains without trusted relayers.
proof_system: zk-SNARK: PLONK or Groth16 (Gnark-based). BLS12-381 pairing circuits for consensus proofs. Trusted setup for Groth16 components.

name: Nori Bridge
deployment_status: devnet
zk_use: The Helios Ethereum light client runs in a zkVM, its PLONK-wrapped proof is converted into a Mina-verifiable proof that posts Ethereum state roots on Mina, against which deposits are proven to mint nETH.
proof_system: Hybrid

name: InterLink
deployment_status: devnet
zk_use: Halo2 circuits with Groth16 (BN254) on-chain verification prove Merkle inclusion and source-chain consensus participation for settlement on a Solana hub, a 3-of-5 validator threshold signature co-signs settlement bundles.
proof_system: Groth16
